 Minnesota Timberwolves Utah Jazz The Minnesota Timberwolves are off to a fast start in the 2026-27 season, winning seven of their 10 games while covering the spread in 90 percent of them – the best mark in the NBA.
--> The Minnesota Timberwolves are off to a fast start in the 2026-27 season, winning seven of their 10 games while covering the spread in 90 percent of them – the best mark in the NBA.
 Anthony Edwards (knee) is out of the lineup for the next few months, but the Wolves have the No. 3 defense in the league which has helped them beat some big-time opponents, including a win over Houston last week. 
--> Anthony Edwards (knee) is out of the lineup for the next few months, but the Wolves have the No. 3 defense in the league which has helped them beat some big-time opponents, including a win over Houston last week. 
 Oddsmakers have set the Wolves as 11.5-point favorites at home on Sunday against the Utah Jazz, who are off to a 1-8 start in nine games.
--> Oddsmakers have set the Wolves as 11.5-point favorites at home on Sunday against the Utah Jazz, who are off to a 1-8 start in nine games.
 The Jazz lost Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic to injuries early this season, leaving them extremely thin in the frontcourt after they traded away Walker Kessler in the offseason. Plus, Lauri Markkanen is questionable on Sunday with a wrist injury and guard Keyonte George is questionable with an illness.

 This season, Ball is averaging over three 3-pointers per game on over eight attempts per night for the Timberwolves, and he’s taken on a bigger scoring load with Anthony Edwards (knee) sidelined.  
--> This season, Ball is averaging over three 3-pointers per game on over eight attempts per night for the Timberwolves, and he’s taken on a bigger scoring load with Anthony Edwards (knee) sidelined.  
 Ball has cleared this line in five of his 10 games in the 2026-27 season, yet I’m fading him on Sunday night against the Utah Jazz. 
--> Ball has cleared this line in five of his 10 games in the 2026-27 season, yet I’m fading him on Sunday night against the Utah Jazz. 
 Utah is No. 10 in the league in opponent 3s made per game, and Ball has seven games this season with fewer than 13 3-point attempts, clearing this line in just two of them. So, if the volume isn’t there against Utah, he’s going to have a tough time hitting four or more shots from deep.

 While the former top-five pick is shooting 38.4 percent from deep, I think this a tough matchup for him on Sunday.

--> Utah has been one of the worst teams in the league to open the season, ranking 26th in net rating while winning just one of nine games.
 After making some win-now moves last season and in the offseason, the Jazz are struggling with Jusuf Nurkic and Jaren Jackson Jr. injured, and it has put them in a tough spot on the road against this Timberwolves team.
--> After making some win-now moves last season and in the offseason, the Jazz are struggling with Jusuf Nurkic and Jaren Jackson Jr. injured, and it has put them in a tough spot on the road against this Timberwolves team.
 Anthony Edwards may be out, but the Wolves are No. 1 in the league in net rating, covering the spread in nine of their 10 games. 
--> Anthony Edwards may be out, but the Wolves are No. 1 in the league in net rating, covering the spread in nine of their 10 games. 
 Meanwhile, Utah is a league-worst 1-8 against the spread and hasn’t covered in a game on the road (0-4). 
--> Meanwhile, Utah is a league-worst 1-8 against the spread and hasn’t covered in a game on the road (0-4). 
 With the Jazz still down multiple rotation players, I can’t back them against a Wolves team that is eighth in offense and third in defense through the first three weeks of regular-season action. 
--> With the Jazz still down multiple rotation players, I can’t back them against a Wolves team that is eighth in offense and third in defense through the first three weeks of regular-season action.
